Name: No-Belt Overalls
Author: BadMoonBeast
Description:
[i]I've never worn a belt over overalls in my life.

[/i][b]What It Does:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changes the appearance of three character creator overalls shirts (not the tailored ones)
[*]Includes the red, green, and white versions with blue overalls
[*]Removes the belt and changes the back into straps like actual overalls
[/list]
If there is interest, I might add some of the other overalls shirts.

[b]Please note[/b] that you will require [b]both[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] in order for this mod to work.
